subject: english
question:
**Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

Fashion is not something **__that exists in__** dresses only.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **No Improvement.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Option 3, "No improvement," **is the correct answer. 
 
• The original sentence is grammatically correct.
 
• **"Exists in" **is the correct phrasal verb to use with **"fashion"** in this context.
 
• The sentence means that fashion is not limited to dresses only, but can be found in other areas as well. 
 
• There is no need to change **"exists in"** to** "exist of," "existing at,"** or** "which exist on"** as they do not convey the intended meaning of the sentence. Therefore,** option 3** is the correct answer.
